G'oya

Avval har bir to'lovga CASE bilan guruh nomini beramiz, keyin aynan shu ifoda bo'yicha guruhlaymiz. NULL ni ajratish uchun shartli CASE va IS NULL kerak: oddiy CASE method WHEN NULL hech qachon ishlamaydi.

Yechim

SELECT CASE
         WHEN method IS NULL THEN 'ko''rsatilmagan'
         WHEN method = 'card' THEN 'karta'
         WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 'naqd'
         ELSE 'boshqa'
       END AS method_name,
       COUNT(*) AS payments,
       SUM(amount) AS total
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1

GROUP BY 1 "birinchi ustun bo'yicha" degani, CASE ni ikkinchi marta yozmaslik uchun. Namunada transfer va payme bitta boshqa qatoriga tushadi: 2 ta to'lov, 560 000.

Tuzoqlar

Oddiy CASE method WHEN NULL THEN ... aslida method = NULL ni tekshiradi. NULL bilan har qanday solishtirish rost emas, shuning uchun bu shart hech qachon ishlamaydi va Jasur bilan Nilufarning to'lovlari boshqa ga qo'shilib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT CASE method
         WHEN 'card' THEN 'karta'
         WHEN 'cash' THEN 'naqd'
         WHEN NULL THEN 'ko''rsatilmagan'
         ELSE 'boshqa'
       END AS method_name,
       COUNT(*) AS payments,
       SUM(amount) AS total
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1

GROUP BY method yozsangiz, guruhlar hali asl qiymatlar bo'yicha tuziladi va boshqa ikki qatorda chiqadi: biri transfer, biri payme uchun.

COUNT(method) ham to'g'ri emas: u NULL larni sanamaydi va ko'rsatilmagan qatorida 0 chiqadi.
